corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez numeral for 'seven' (masculine accusative) is 'ሰብዐተ' (from ሰብዑ/ሰብዐቱ), and the printed glyph clearly shows the rounded ዐ (4th order ዐይን) rather than አ.
The cross-reference to John 20:14 (where Jesus appears to Mary Magdalene) is printed as ፲፬ (14), where the bottom loop of ፬ was misread as ፮.
The passive infinitive 'መወደድ' (being loved, matching L30 'ተወዳጅ' and L34 'መወደድ') is printed with 1st-order ወ, not 6th-order ው.
